# Security Policy
# https://securitytxt.org/ — RFC 9116

Contact: mailto:brent.beckwith@gmail.com
Preferred-Languages: en
Expires: 2027-05-20T00:00:00.000Z

# Security measures implemented:
# - Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
# - Input sanitization on chat API
# - Prompt injection defense (multi-layer: input validation, safety scoring, adversarial testing)
# - Rate limiting on API endpoints
# - No user data stored — stateless chat sessions
# - Automated eval suite including security and jailbreak tests
# - Weekly adversarial testing with auto-generated attack vectors
